description: Habib Bank Limited is a full-service commercial bank and was the first commercial bank established in Pakistan, in 1947. It operates over 1,740 branches and 2,300+ ATMs globally and serves more than 40 million clients, with operations spanning retail banking, corporate and investment banking, treasury, SME and agriculture banking, financial institutions and global trade services, transaction banking and Islamic banking.
